extensionPolicy: Append stable IDs in new versions. Old runs remain not_checked for newly added IDs. Missing policy is not inferred from retrieval failure.

requirements.question: What uses are permitted or prohibited in coursework, by whom and under which conditions?
What restrictions apply to exams and specific assessment settings?
How do university, unit and course rules interact according to official authority?
Which acknowledgement, citation and process records are mandatory, recommended or discretionary?
Which misconduct rules explicitly cover AI and which are general frameworks?
Are AI detectors used, permitted or restricted, and what evidentiary role is supported?
Who investigates and decides, and what response, hearing or representation rights apply?
What outcomes are possible or required and for which groups, cases and repeat offences?
What review or appeal stages, deadlines, units, start events and exceptions apply?
What relevant advocacy, support, accessibility or accompaniment is provided and to whom?
Which personal, confidential, research or classified data may be used and subject to what approval?
What logging, retention, audit, search-query, training and third-party conditions apply?
Which named tools and versions are available, to which users and with which accounts, seats and costs?
Distinguish access, recommendation, procurement and data approval from assessment permission.
Which research, thesis, publication, authorship and disclosure rules apply?
Which ethics, security, procurement or use-case approvals apply?
Which copyright, ownership or confidential-material restrictions are explicit?
Which reasonable adjustment or assistive-use exceptions are explicit?
What restrictions govern AI grading or uploading student work, including consent?
Record registry/academic, teaching, library, IT, research and policy-PDF discovery, scoped to the institution.
Bind original-language quotes and necessary context to exact snapshots and actual PDF locations.
Distinguish publication, effective, revision, retrieval and review dates; seek superseding and conflicting official sources.
Check redirects, soft failures, extraction shells, hash kind and historical snapshot relationships.
Cover every public Claim ID and separate supplementary, tool, held and student-snapshot objects.
Record every applicable data, changes, MCP, snapshot, runtime, sitemap and notification synchronization result.
Reconcile separately published tool IDs and MCP discovery, including eligibility, costs and evidence; claim totals are insufficient.
Do not derive coursework/exam permission or coverage from tool access alone; validate referenced IDs and independently review scope and modality.
Reconcile reviewed facts, scope and modality across topics, quick guides, FAQ, actions, comparison and illustration copy.
Bind original PDF bytes, extraction, physical-page rendering and quote locations to one artifact; distinguish frozen verification from current live-byte verification.
Separate global dataset, university and page revisions and all policy, capture, review, publication, index and response timestamps.
Read historical revisions from their frozen packages; verify cold and stable changes/history routes and all affected change surfaces.
Record exact tested sets and local, committed, pushed, candidate, deployed and public-verified stages; retain failures without inflating semantic approval.
Keep the existing clean UI; make all applicable public evidence and audit detail traceable through existing detail/history entries without exposing private artifacts.
